content:
Mira: Quick heads-up — I pushed the terraform/bridge-modules v0.1.0 PR to the partners repo. Need partner + eng review for the marketplace listing. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/partners/bridge-modules/pull/42

Ben: Reviewing now. Quick checklist I want covered: provider version pins, simple examples, clear outputs, and a short smoke CI job.

Carlos: On it. I'll add conditional device profiles for A100 and Graviton/Arm. Planning a small `instance_type` map to pick flavors.

repo-bot: CI: 12/12 checks passed on PR #42 — all green :white_check_mark:

Josh: Can we include a minimal examples/minimal that shows both hosted and dedicated configs? Partners keep asking for a one-file deploy they can eyeball.

Dana: Marketing/legal note — if we want the marketplace entry next week we need partner logo + security questionnaire + a one-pager by Friday. Also want a 60s demo clip for the listing.

Mira: Acceptance criteria for the release: 1) terraform fmt + validate CI, 2) cross-cloud samples (AWS + GCP at least), 3) GH Actions smoke job that runs `terraform plan` (no resources created), 4) partner signoff on README and vars. Target: cut release tag Friday EOD.

Ben: I'll add the GH Actions smoke job. Proposed job snippet to drop into .github/workflows/smoke.yml:
```
name: smoke
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v3
  - name: Setup Terraform
    uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
  - name: terraform fmt + init + validate
    run: |
      terraform -chdir=examples/minimal fmt -check
      terraform -chdir=examples/minimal init -input=false
      terraform -chdir=examples/minimal validate
```

Carlos: Two notes: pin the providers to avoid surprising drift; and add a variables.tf with an `instance_type` map keyed by arch. Minimal example snippet:
```
variable "instance_type" {
  type = map(string)
  default = {
    x86 = "n1-standard-4"
    arm = "t4g.medium"
  }
}

module "rw_bridge" {
  source = "../modules/bridge"
  cloud  = "aws"
  instance_type = var.instance_type[terraform.platform]
}
```

Dana: I'm adding the stakeholder list in the partner brief: @partner-eng, @legal, @marketing. I'll ping them once we have the final README and the one-pager.

Mira: Can @Carlos and @Ben sign off before EOD Friday? Also need a 3–4 line README snippet explaining dedicated capacity toggles and required IAM scopes.

Ben: Yes — will sign off after I land the smoke workflow and provider pins.

Carlos: I'll push the arm/x86 map and a tiny GH Action that runs `terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan` but doesn't apply. Keeps partners comfortable.

repo-bot: Draft release tag created: v0.1.0-rc (created by Mira) — awaiting approvals.

Mira: Awesome. Once you both approve I'll cut the final tag and post the partner update with the short checklist and demo slot. :rocket:
